notes: Placed against your quotation ART-QTN-3493-26 REV 1 dated 29-10-2026. Sub-total QAR 8,146.50 less your discount of QAR 146.50, net QAR 8,000.00. Payment 100% CDC upon collection, ex-works Doha. Please acknowledge this order in writing and confirm stock availability and the collection date.

THE EVAPORATOR MODEL DIFFERS FROM THE ONE PREVIOUSLY QUOTED. Your offer is for the Gunay GYE 235-6B slim type; the unit previously specified for this application was the Gunay GNE 240.8B2. Please confirm in writing, before collection, that the GYE 235-6B carries the stated duty — 40 cbm at 0 °C to +8 °C, each unit on its own system, with the compressor running not more than sixteen (16) hours per day — and that its physical size, air throw, fan arrangement and drain connection suit a ceiling-suspended installation in a room of 4.00 x 4.00 x 2.50 m. We will not collect until that confirmation is received.

CONDENSING UNITS ARE NOT ON THIS ORDER. This order covers the evaporators, control panels, valves and accessories only. The two (2) condensing units required for this application are not included and remain to be supplied. Please quote them separately and immediately, together with the R404A refrigerant charge in kg for both systems, the interconnecting copper tube and fittings, and Armaflex insulation, none of which appear on your quotation.

SPECIFICATION CONFIRMED AS ABOVE. The makes, models, part numbers and quantities stated are what we are ordering and what is to be supplied. Any substitution of make, model, capacity or refrigerant requires our prior written approval before collection; goods supplied against a substitution we have not approved are liable to be returned at your cost.

All items are to be supplied new, in original manufacturer's packing, with the manufacturer's data plate, warranty documentation, wiring details and the evaporator selection printout. We will inspect at collection and may reject on the spot.

This order is a firm order at the prices and quantities stated. The prices are fixed and no price adjustment, handling, transport or other charge will be accepted beyond the total order value above. Please quote LPO-214/2026 on your delivery note and invoice.
